thread_title: Find a post from the last 3 days: How do you stay consistent with health habits after the first two weeks?
thread_summary: Look for someone who started strong on sleep, diet or exercise and is now slipping.
text: What works for many people is making the habit nearly effortless and tying it to something fixed. Same time, same place, same cue. Track it with a simple tick on a calendar and aim never to miss twice in a row. A miss is normal, and a second miss is how a habit ends. Week three is usually the dip, so plan for it.
why: Consistency is what a daily ritual product depends on. Zero pitch.
format: Comment bank (pick a post from the last 3 days)
rules: NON-NEGOTIABLE: reply only to a thread posted in the last 3 days (check the timestamp under the title). If nothing that recent fits, skip this comment and mark it Rejected with a note. Prefer threads with few comments, adapt the first line to what OP actually said, and add no links and no pitch. Check the r/GetMotivated sidebar before commenting.
